verdict.rationale: The UK IPO runs digital services for searching, filing and managing IP rights, so AI-generated insights within those services are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only conventional keyword, owner, number and image search, plus online filing and tracking. Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions from a user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
